lines.text: Givedetailedanswerstothefollowingquestions:
Name three types of plateaus and explain how they were formed. Give one example of each.
What are different types of valleys? Explain any two of them.
What are the effects of physical environment on humans?
Learning Activity
Identify major mountain ranges, valleys and plateaus on a physical map of the world.
Glossary
Tectonic Plates: Lithospheric plates causing mountain building, earthquakes etc:
Converging Plates: Two tectonic plates moving towards each other are termed as
convergingplates.
Inhospitable: Unfit for residence.
Transhumance: Practice of moving livestock seasonally.
Diastrophism: All processes that move, elevate or build up portions of the Earth's crust
come under diastrophism.
Normal fault: Afault is said to be normal when movement on either side of it is vertical.
Distribution map: Maps used to show the aerial distribution of population, crops,
minerals,etc.,areknownasdistribution'maps.
Statistical diagram: The diagrams representing statistical data are known as statistical
diagrams.
Planar coordinate system: Planar coordinate systems present location on the flat
surfaceofamap.
Geographic coordinate system: A geographic coordinate system is used to define
locationsonaglobe.
